title: 🌧️ The world screams through headlines of fear.
paragraphs:
🌧️ The world screams through headlines of fear.
☀️ But faith listens to promises that never expire.
When you fix your eyes on His word, the noise fades — and peace takes the mic.
📖 Verse: “For we walk by faith, not by sight.” — 2 Corinthians 5:7
💬 What headline are you choosing to believe today? Drop a “🙏” if you’re walking by faith, not fear.
